e693b_directions.question: can weights alone name the sixteen directions through which the weak write matters (e693's pca16)?
D1: the removed write projected on the next block's 16 dominant read directions (gamma folded) halves the zeroing cost
D1b: on its 64 dominant read directions it halves the cost
D2: on all later blocks' 16 dominant read directions it halves the cost
D3: the weak write's 16 principal directions overlap the next block's 16 read directions by more than 0.3
D3b: and all later reads' 16 by more than 0.3
D4: projected on the unembedding's 16 directions it halves the cost
D5: the first principal direction has more than 0.3 of its norm in the stream mean's 4 largest coordinates (massive activations)
D6: the best weights-only 16-direction subspace costs at most 1.2 times e693's data-derived 16
D7: the weak write on the strong write's own 16 principal directions (the kept quarter's write, data, no weights) costs at most 1.2 times the weak write's own 16: the weak activations write where the strong ones write
D8: the weak write's 16 directions overlap the strong write's 16 by more than 0.5

revisions: 2026-10-19 before the full runs (the pythia160 smoke had shown the weights-only subspaces far behind the data-derived sixteen): added the strong write's and the whole MLP write's principal directions as rungs and overlaps (D7, D8), to tell a dimmer copy of the strong write from a signal of its own.
